steps.description: Amend docs/adr/ADR-006-resume-contract.md: insert step 3.6 (rehydrate completed-stage artifacts; absent artifact after restore causes exit 1) and add enforcing test names (resume-rehydrate-test.sh, resume-entry-points-test.sh) inline; step 3.5 covers cycle_iterations amendment — use 3.6 to avoid collision
Amend docs/adr/ADR-050-prior-work-reuse-contract.md §6: add boundary note that resume (same run, ADR-006) is distinct from new-run reuse (ADR-050 §6 governs)
Add _artifact_persist_put_back <from> <to> to core/state/artifact-persist.sh (no-clobber copy skipping stage-io/); body identical to current _hydrate_put_back
Redirect plugins/tool/hydrate/plugin.sh _hydrate_put_back call site to _artifact_persist_put_back (hydrate already sources artifact-persist.sh)
Update tests/unit/hydrate-stage-test.sh: redirect the direct _hydrate_put_back call at line 216 to _artifact_persist_put_back

Fix _cycle_orchestrator_run_body in core/pipeline/cycle-orchestrator.sh: guard the current_iter read with [[ ${_ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE:-false} == true ]]; when not in resume mode, use _start_iter=1 unconditionally (restoring old behaviour for fresh runs and nested-loop re-entries)

In runner.sh, after the _runner_resume_rehydrate call at the resume entry point, export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true (before the dispatch loop) so cycle orchestrators know they are in resume context; unset or leave scoped to the run — do NOT set it for fresh runs

Confirm tests/integration/cycle-inner-iter-resets-per-outer-iter-test.sh, tests/integration/nested-loop-rounds-test.sh, tests/integration/nested-loop-rounds-build-test.sh, and tests/integration/cycle-member-dispatch-events-test.sh pass after the guard fix (they were broken by the unconditional read)

Update tests/integration/resume-loop-state-test.sh: add export _ZBUILD_RESUME_ACTIVE=true before the cycle_orchestrator_run call (the test calls the orchestrator directly, bypassing runner.sh; without this the guard prevents reading current_iter and SPEC-7 "first dispatched iter is 2" fails); SPEC-7 "first dispatched iter is 2" must still pass; "no iter=1 complete" assertion must use wc -l not grep -c || echo 0

Update tests/integration/resume-rehydrate-test.sh: fix all "expected 0" assertions to use wc -l | tr -d ' ' instead of grep -c '^...$' 2>/dev/null || echo 0 (the latter produces "0\n0" when count=0, causing assert_eq to fail); for SPEC-12 fresh-run sub-case, add --no-resume flag to the runner invocation to prevent auto-resume (status=in_progress + recent timestamp triggers auto_resume); change SPEC-12 "cycled dispatched" assertion to "intake dispatched via cyclic fixture" (same pattern as from-stage SPEC-13: verify template has type:cycle AND intake dispatched); change SPEC-13 "cycled dispatched" assertion to "intake dispatched via cyclic fixture" for the same reason
Update tests/integration/from-stage-rehydrate-test.sh: fix the SPEC-3 "intake emits no stage.start" assertion to use wc -l | tr -d ' ' instead of grep -c || echo 0
Update tests/integration/resume-entry-points-test.sh: change SPEC-13 "cycled dispatched" assertion to "intake dispatched via cyclic fixture" (template has type:cycle AND intake dispatched)

Update tests/integration/pipeline-resume-test.sh: pre-write intake's primary artifact to ZBUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR before the --resume run so SPEC-2 fail-closed path does not break the existing exit-0 assertion

Update tests/integration/resume-after-sigint-test.sh: ensure Phase 1 intake stub writes intake-result.json; if the stub from mock_plugin_factory does not write it, replace with a stub that does; confirm P2.T1 (rc=0) still passes
Run npm test and confirm full suite green
